item.title: Nitecore NB10000 Gen 4: Lightest 10k mAh Power Bank
item.description: Nitecore’s NB10000 Gen 4 packs 10,000 mAh into a 146‑gram, 1.45 × 11.6 × 4.68 cm case, setting a new benchmark for the lightest 10k mAh power bank.
